resources and you need to very much
focus those on the one things that are
making the most money, which is probably
running ads and doing launches.
>> Yeah, you're right.
>> Yeah, and so like everything that's not
that is probably taking away. And just
streamline the delivery so that you can
like one of the things that's a big
misconception or mistake I think that
happens especially with digital
products and memberships is that people
try to put too much in them, right? They
think oh, I'm going to solve this by
more. But you don't solve it by making
more, you solve it by making better and
fewer. Because you have to think about
value per second. If you make 10 things
and people only consume one, even if
it's good, they think they're only

for them to consume all of the digital
assets that you give them and just make

think more ads, more launches. And
